features:
CHEWY GRANOLA BARS: Protein Granola Bars made with roasted peanuts, almonds and sunflower seeds dipped in luscious dark chocolate; A must-have for an on-the-go snack

PROTEIN: Contains 10g of protein per serving; The perfect snack to help keep you going

PERFECTLY PORTABLE: Convenient bars for snack time or an on-the-go invigorating treat; Perfect for the pantry, lunch box, and hiking trail

GREAT SNACK: No artificial flavors, artificial colors, or high fructose corn syrup

CONTAINS: One 7.1 oz box of Nature Valley Peanut Almond Dark Chocolate Protein Granola Bars; 5 bars
ingredients: Roasted Peanuts, Almonds, Soy Protein Isolate, Chicory Root Extract, Sugar, Corn Syrup, Vegetable Oils (palm, palm kernel, canola), Whey Protein Concentrate, Roasted Sunflower Seeds (sunflower seeds, sunflower oil), Toasted Coconut, Fructose, Vegetable Glycerin, Rice Starch, Cocoa, Corn Starch, Soy Lecithin, Salt, Dextrose, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor.
